version: v3 compact (Vegetation Art Standard v1.1, adopted 14-11-2026)
notes: Pixel coordinates in the picture, (0, 0) at its top left. foot: the point placed on the middle of the tree tile's bottom edge. crown_line: the first row of the trunk; the rows above it are the crown, which fades (Forest Visibility specification v1.3, O3). crown_bounds: [x, y, width, height] of the crown, used to find which crowns cover a colonist (O9, O11).
